note: Separate from jcs-golden-vectors.json, which records the assembly-id profile. Same contract: canonical is the exact UTF-8 byte string and full_digest is SHA-256 of those bytes. Identity vectors also carry rendered_id as their prefix plus the first 32 lowercase hex characters. cycle_hash has no rendered form on the wire — it is stored as the full digest — so its vector deliberately omits rendered_id. Generated with packages/shared/src/jcs.ts, the same canonicalizer the Worker calls.

vectors.name: cycle-pass-identity-pass-two
vectors.description: The retrograde middle pass of a three-pass Saturn square. Only the parent cycle id and the 1-based index enter the preimage: refinement may move a pass's exact_at, and the id must not move with it.

vectors.name: cycle-hash-retrograde
vectors.description: The normalized three-pass cycle exactly as scanned, minus importance_score. Pass order is part of the hash because JCS deliberately preserves array order, and orb_deg 3.0 canonicalizes as 3 under the ECMAScript number rule.
